280-1238-8323-8324.easyPrerequisites: You're able to play a land this turn.
280-1238-8323-8324.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it and Avatar of Burgeoning Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Avatar of Burgeoning Echoes trigger, causing you to create a Jace planeswalker token and put two loyalty counters on it.
Activate the Jace token by removing a loyalty counter from it.
Way of the Paradox triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and allowing you to play another land this turn.
Resolve the Jace token's ability, causing you to surveil 1.
Activate Heart of Kiran's crew ability by removing a loyalty counter from the Jace token.
The Jace token is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having no loyalty.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability.
Repeat.

4186-4279-6097.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
4186-4279-6097.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Hinterland Sanctifier trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

751-6006-6791.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1315-3234-3293-3899.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
1315-3234-3293-3899.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat
1315-3234-3293-3899.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1981-2415-2921-5789.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2921-5789.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1170-2350-2829-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2350-2829-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Stone Calendar.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager
Repeat.

2557-5478-6441-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
2557-5478-6441-7824-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

2034-5003-7908.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing The Notary Hobbits, adding {C}{C}.
When The Notary Hobbits dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return The Notary Hobbits from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When The Notary Hobbits enters, it triggers, creating two token copies of it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1020-2034-2866-7693.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
1020-2034-2866-7693.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Armor Wars.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Armor Wars.
Repeat.

3457-4478-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate one of the Seeker of Skybreak tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Seeker of Skybreak token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1402-3593-3967-4359.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Diamond Lion from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Garna from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Garna enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Diamond Lion by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Garna.
Resolve the Garna ability from step 3, returning all creature cards that were put in your graveyard this turn to your hand.
Repeat.

1308-5742-5743-7178.description:
Activate Iron-Shield Elf by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Iron-Shield Elf ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4824-5343.description:
Activate Soliton by tapping it, adding {U}{U} and causing the next spell you cast to have cascade.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
4824-5343.notes: Optionally, you may cast any spell to get infinite cascade triggers based off the mana value of that spell.

4311-5078-6595.description:

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Lyse's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat

222-527-2511-4927.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2511-4927.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

4508-5184-5880-5929.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

222-527-2034-2079.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1652-2713-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Patron of the Arts.
When Patron of the Arts enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2438-5663--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2438-5663--5.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

222-2438-4647-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Saproling.
222-2438-4647-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing a nontoken creature you control and Slimefoot and Squee.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder abilities, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

539-1430-4385-4552.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {0}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
Repeat.

1127-2440-5115.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Spirits.
1127-2440-5115.description:
Activate Blinking Spirit by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Blinking Spirit by paying {3}{W}.
When Blinking Spirit enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {2}, putting a charge counter on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
If you control six or more Spirits, this combo nets infinite mana.

518-3111.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal damage to Protector of the Crown.
You have a way to give Protector of the Crown indestructible.
518-3111.description:
Give Protector of the Crown indestructible, if needed.
Cast Arcbond by paying {2}{R}, targeting Protector of the Crown.
Deal damage to Protector of the Crown.
Arcbond triggers, dealing damage to each creature and player equal to the damage dealt to Protector of the Crown, with the damage that would be dealt to you being dealt to Protector of the Crown instead.
Repeat from step 4.

1247-1656-3371.manaNeeded: {4}, plus enough mana to pay for the nonland card's mana cost minus {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}
1247-1656-3371.notablePrerequisites:
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one nonland card in hand.
1247-1656-3371.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Codie's ability by paying {4} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat as desired, skipping step 2 on the final iteration.
Cast any spell by paying its mana cost, reduced by the {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} added in step 1.
Necrotic Ooze triggers for each time you activated Codie's ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.
You may also repeat this combo for each nonland card in your hand as mana permits, and on subsequent turns.

624-784-3327-3719.notablePrerequisites:
Dargo and Silas Renn are your commanders.
You have sacrificed at least two artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
You control a Treasure token.
624-784-3327-3719.description:

Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Phantasmal Image from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Phantasmal Image enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Dargo and create seven Treasure tokens.
Choose to put Dargo into the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}{R}.
Repeat.

1365-2034-4853-4907.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Tatterkite persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Tatterkite, adding {C}{C}.
Tatterkite dies, triggering its persist ability and Dross Scorpion.
Resolve the Tatterkite trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with no -1/-1 counters on it.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Repeat.

643-3510-4488.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand.
643-3510-4488.description:
Play any land from your hand.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Rampaging Baloths, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
The Beast enters the battlefield as a Saproling due to Maskwood Nexus, which also causes it to be a Forest land due to Life and Limb.
Rampaging Baloths triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Repeat from step 3.
